docker.pytorch_image_registry_attempt: stalled on layer retrieval; stopped without repeated large-image download

formal_boundary: Docker CUDA visibility passed using an already-present CUDA base image. The deterministic operator construction STOP occurred on host-local PyTorch 2.5.1+cu121 because the matching GPU-enabled PyTorch image was not cached and retrieval stalled. Issue #4546 explicitly permits already-installed host-local CUDA when a local GPU container runtime is unavailable; no formal training ran.
